turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Oatmeal is a great start. How are things in the science department today?

turns.text: I imagine so! Did Olive greet you when you got back to the house?

turns.text: It's typical Portland spring weather—a little damp, but not too cold. It actually reminds me a bit of the weather we had on a couple of days during our family trip to Japan.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Ah, that trip must have been so memorable. How is your neighbor's vegetable garden doing?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: It's coming along great, they've got some neat little sprouts coming up. As for me, I'm just planning a quiet night. I think my evening TV show is going to be a nature documentary.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: That sounds like a wonderfully relaxing way to spend your Thursday evening. Have a great night, Marcus!

turns.speaker: user
